title: Mateo Kovacic: Man City count on me despite exit rumours
excerpt: Manchester City midfielder Mateo Kovacic has moved to address speculation over his future, telling reporters that the club “count on me” even as he has been linked with a move away
intro:
Manchester City midfielder Mateo Kovacic has moved to address speculation over his future, telling reporters that the club “count on me” even as he has been linked with a move away this summer. The comments, reported by BBC Sport, come amid ongoing transfer chatter around several high-profile Premier League squads.

Kovacic’s short statement is the clearest public response so far to the rumours tying him to potential departures. For supporters and observers, it underlines a familiar truth of elite football: players often face speculation while still remaining focused on their current club duties.

sections.heading: What Kovacic actually said and the immediate context
sections.text:
BBC Sport relayed Kovacic’s message that Manchester City “count on me” while also noting he has been linked with a move away this summer. Those two facts — his reassurance and the transfer links — are the only confirmed elements of the story at this stage. The quote is brief but direct, and it functions as a public affirmation of his availability and role at the club.

Outside of that statement, there are no confirmed details in the BBC Sport report about interested clubs, negotiation status, or any personal decision from the player beyond the acknowledgement of the transfer speculation. As ever in football coverage, a short public comment can both calm supporters and leave room for further developments behind the scenes.

sections.heading: Why such statements matter at top clubs
sections.text:
At elite teams like Manchester City, where competition for places is intense and squad rotation is common, short public reassurances by players carry weight. A player acknowledging that the club counts on him can be intended to reassure teammates, coaching staff and fans that he remains committed in the short term.

General background: Manchester City are one of the leading clubs in English football, competing in the Premier League and European competitions. Mateo Kovacic is widely known as a central midfielder with international experience, and players in his position are often the subject of transfer speculation because of their tactical importance. In that context, a concise comment from a player can be as much about managing perceptions as about confirming future plans.

analysis:
This brief episode illustrates how modern transfer windows generate a steady flow of media narratives that clubs and players must manage. Kovacic’s statement can be read as an attempt to stabilise the narrative — signalling professionalism and present commitment — while still leaving room for possible negotiations. Analysts might see such remarks as standard public relations responses: neither a firm denial nor an explicit confirmation of any move.

From a sporting perspective, clubs often seek to minimise distraction during critical phases of a season or pre-season. For a player, acknowledging rumours while reaffirming availability helps maintain team cohesion. That said, until concrete transfer activity is publicly documented by reliable sources, any further interpretation remains speculative.

faq.question: What did Mateo Kovacic say about his future?
faq.answer: According to BBC Sport, Kovacic said the club "count on me" while he has been linked with a move away this summer. That is the confirmed public comment reported.

faq.question: Is Kovacic definitely leaving Manchester City this summer?
faq.answer: The BBC Sport report only states that he has been linked with a move away and that he said the club "count on me". It does not confirm any transfer has been agreed or that he will leave.

faq.question: What is Mateo Kovacic’s role at Manchester City?
faq.answer: Kovacic is a midfielder at Manchester City. As a central/creative midfielder, his role typically involves linking defence and attack and contributing to ball circulation — responsibilities common to players in his position at top clubs.

conclusion: Kovacic’s succinct reply — that City “count on me” — is the only clear public detail reported by BBC Sport amid ongoing transfer links. For now, it serves as a firm but measured reminder of his present status, while the wider transfer story remains open to further developments.
